# `snapshot-pairs`

Snapshot-diff fixture definition (plan Sections 15, 17/P3.1). Like the other
fixtures, this directory tracks the *definition*; the two trees are generated
by `seed` and the mutation block in
`crates/ghosttrace-cli/tests/snapshot_diff.rs`.

## Generated shape

Capture 1:

```
<evidence>/
├── unchanged.txt     "same\n"
├── same_meta.txt     "AAAA\n"
├── metadata.txt      "meta\n"
├── changed.txt       "before\n"
├── gone.txt          "gone\n"
└── moved-src.txt     "move me\n"
```

Between captures: `same_meta.txt` becomes `"BBBB\n"` with its mtime restored;
`metadata.txt` keeps its bytes and gets an older mtime; `changed.txt` is
rewritten longer; `gone.txt` is removed; `moved-src.txt` is renamed to
`moved-dst.txt`; `appeared.txt` is created.

## Expected diff (capture 1 → capture 2)

| Path | Class |
|---|---|
| `unchanged.txt` | `unchanged` |
| `same_meta.txt` | `content_changed_equal_metadata` |
| `metadata.txt` | `metadata_changed` |
| `changed.txt` | `content_changed` |
| `gone.txt` | `not_present_in_captured_scope` |
| `moved-src.txt`, `moved-dst.txt` | `move_candidate` (both sides) |
| `appeared.txt` | `appeared` |

Additional vectors in the same test file: a later capture with every file
excluded (`--max-file-bytes 0`) turns absence into `unknown` with a coverage-gap
reason, and two captures of different roots report `scope_compatible: false`
with every row `unknown`.
